text:
The defendant is most likely guilty of murder in the second scenario: lending his car to a friend he knew was extremely intoxicated, after which she ran a red light and killed the victim. This can support murder under a depraved-heart theory because knowingly entrusting a vehicle to an obviously drunk driver shows reckless indifference to an unjustifiably high risk to human life. The first scenario lacks the requisite malice, as the defendant did not cause or foresee the robber's independent criminal act.
CONFIDENCE: 85
